f1.quote: The study compared CrFeTaVW with Ta-substituted-by-Ti CrFeTiVW

f2.quote: using conventional molecular dynamics (MD) and hybrid MD/Monte Carlo (MC) atom-swap simulations

f3.quote: mechanically alloyed the elemental powders by planetary ball milling (350 rpm, 2 h, WC media, 10:1 ball-to-powder ratio)

f4.quote: SPS was performed for 5 min at 1543 K/70 MPa

f5.quote: Laser-flash thermal diffusivity was measured under 0.05 bar He from 300 to 1000 K

f6.quote: Simulations used periodic boundaries, an NPT ensemble at 1 atm, ... 6×10^6 time steps, and in hybrid MC an attempted unlike-atom swap every 10 MD steps

f7.quote: Relative to conventional MD, hybrid MC was expected to yield lower-energy, more stable configurations

f8.quote: stronger W-related segregation in CrFeTiVW than in CrFeTaVW

f10.quote: Replacing Ta with Ti was predicted to alter the consolidated phase constitution—from bcc plus a Laves phase to two bcc-derived phases

f11.quote: without materially changing thermal diffusivity; both alloys were expected to have much lower diffusivity than pure W or CuCrZr
